summary: This directory serves as a foundational layer providing shared utilities and infrastructure for project identification, file system path manipulation, and module resolution, ensuring consistency across build and tooling operations.
responsibilities: Discover and validate TypeScript projects within a workspace
Perform cross-platform file system path resolution and transformation
Standardize mapping between source files, output paths, and module specifiers
Extract and aggregate project-level metadata and configuration
relationships: Workspace discovery logic identifies projects, which in turn provide the scope for path resolution and module mapping operations.
Path transformation relies on workspace identification to define the project scope for absolute and relative paths.
Module specifier logic uses path resolution to translate logical imports into physical source files within the identified project structure.
designDecisions: Centralization of core tooling logic to prevent duplication across build processes
Encapsulation of environment-specific file system operations
Use of standardized interfaces for project and workspace metadata
Decoupling of project discovery from structural analysis
